name: Eric Bischoff
caption: The WCW president whose protest, in the fed's news of 8 June 2008, fails to stop Panda Energy's purchase of World Championship Wrestling and its merger into TNA.

tenures.source: the WCW fan federation's own title history (promotions/wcw-nitro-2001/archive/wcw-title-histories.html), World Heavyweight Championship footnote 9: 'Bischoff holds ttle up nearly two months'; and the TNA fan federation's news of 8 June 2008, which calls him WCW President

The WCW fan federation that TNA's news has merge into TNA also bills a Jeff Jarrett, a titleholder in its own title history whose last dated reign is of 24 March 2002. TNA's news names this Jarrett as TNA's executive and not among the WCW stars who move across, so the two stay separate on a presumed reading; a page that ties them would reopen it.
